About the Major Taylor Cycling PGH Wednesday Ride group ride

A weekly no-drop tour around the city from OTB on the South Side, twelve to eighteen miles at a casual pace. Run by the local Major Taylor club, whose membership is open to all.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
